milestones.title: Deterministic qualification
completed: lib/prospect-qualification.ts: pure deterministic qualifyProspect + staged-row and CRM adapters

Rules: missing website -> find website; missing GBP link -> confirm GBP; social-only = research, not proof; inconclusive audit != problem; geolocation needs real service-area/multi-location evidence (scan area excluded); closed/won/lost/disqualified never priority
Strength and contact readiness derived, not stored; manual overrides for opportunity, confidence and next action
20 tests incl. banned-claim check (no budget/revenue/traffic/rankings)

Actions: shortlist, hold, disqualify (evidence reason required), restore, override opportunity/confidence/next action, import to CRM, link duplicate, skip
Falls back to read-only qualification with a banner if migration 0007 is not yet applied

milestones.title: Campaign-aligned scoring, source semantics, daily workflow
completed: Campaign service is always the primary lane; website design, GBP, local SEO and geolocation scored independently (0-30 need each)

Transparent 100-point model: need 30, fit 20, observable value 20, reachability 15, evidence confidence 15, with documented penalties (identity, inactivity, unit-number ambiguity, no contact, duplicate, conflict)
Evidence states: verified present / verified missing / likely weak / unknown / conflicting; missing GBP or website stays unknown
Legal structure (LLC, Corporation...) no longer treated as industry; Boston mapping stores it as legal_structure; 'Industry not yet verified' shown
Free website check (one page + robots.txt + sitemap.xml, DNS-guarded) and manual review form stored under raw_data.review (source keys untouched)

Queue: 'Your next 10 prospects' with score, service, strength, confidence, one-sentence reason, tasks, next action and progress; filters, score breakdown, source record and advanced controls collapsed; test campaigns excluded by default
Inline server-action errors; pitch-brief location no longer repeats; pitch brief adds score breakdown and verify-before-contact list
